what_this_is: One set of category words for the Connections list (list-every-connection.mjs): a service descriptor's category (records.json) and a computer place's (computer-sources.json) come from two owners' rows, and `same` says which service category is the list's word for the same kind of thing, so a person's messages, pictures or calendar are one group whether they come from a service or from their computer. A category not named here is used as it is; one with none is `none`.
